# ctrl+all

> Every coding agent you pay for, in one inbox, with your team, from your pocket. Claude Code and Codex on one Mac, roles for the team, goals that run overnight. Free beta.

<!-- Keep in sync with /robots.txt and /ai.txt. Generated by site/build-md.py from index.html. -->

Free beta. Needs macOS 14.5 or later. Runs on Apple silicon and Intel. Updates install themselves. The app runs the agent CLIs you already pay for on your own Mac and meters no tokens. Contact: support@ctrlall.app.
